scope: branch-resolved audit of the chiral E6 27 as a reopening of the claim-1559 physical-carrier fork

conventions.chain: E6 -> Spin(10) x U(1)_psi -> SU(4)_C x SU(2)_L x SU(2)_R

stateAccounting.exactEmbedding: H16 can be identified with the Spin(10) 16_1 branch after E6 is reduced to Spin(10) x U(1)_psi
stateAccounting.statisticsBoundary: the 11 extra states in a matter 27 are fermions; the (1,2,2) fermions are not the scalar bidoublet required by the H16 Dirac edges

anomalies.e6Reason: E6 has no invariant symmetric rank-three adjoint tensor and the chiral 27 is perturbatively gauge-anomaly free

patiSalam.extraElevenDecision: the (6,1,1), (1,2,2) and singlet are anomaly-neutral under the semisimple Pati-Salam group

reality.representationType: the E6 27 is complex and inequivalent to bar27

brokenPatiSalamOrdinary.completion: 16 + bar16 + 10 + 1 after forgetting U(1)_psi and the broken E6 generators
brokenPatiSalamOrdinary.qualification: 43 is not an E6 representation and cannot be used while claiming unbroken E6 covariance

outerTwist.automorphism: the E6 diagram Z2 conjugates 27 and bar27
outerTwist.cost: J is semilinear for E6 rt Z2 rather than an ordinary E6-equivariant real structure; disconnected-extension anomalies and symmetry breaking remain unaudited

grading.reason: Schur's lemma makes every operator commuting with the irreducible complex 27 scalar
grading.decision: the H16 grading can be retained only after choosing the broken Pati-Salam decomposition or by treating it as non-E6-equivariant correspondence data

matterCubic27.decision: the E6 cubic supplies a family Dirac channel and exotic masses but no renormalizable right-Majorana carrier

scalar351Prime.majoranaPatiSalamBranch: (10,1,3) inside bar126 in the declared 27 = 16_1 + 10_-2 + 1_4 convention; simultaneous conjugation reverses the naming
scalar351Prime.decision: one 27_F 27_F 351'_H gauge tensor can contain both typed portals, but 351'_H is an additional scalar representation rather than one of the 11 extra matter states

portalWardTest.reason: the diagram involution conjugates complete E6 representations and does not exchange the unequal Spin(10) 10 and bar126 or their Pati-Salam bidoublet and triplet branches
portalWardTest.decision: PARTIAL: E6 improves one-parent-tensor unification but does not supply the normalized parallel source line required by claim 1557

verdict.chiral27Carrier: CONDITIONAL SAT as an anomaly-free E6 matter parent
verdict.literalH16Completion: UNSAT under unbroken E6 because the grading is not equivariant and the extra 11 do not close ordinary J
verdict.ordinaryBrokenPatiSalamReality: 43 states after discarding U(1)_psi and E6 covariance
verdict.351PrimePortalUnification: CONDITIONAL SAT at the gauge-tensor level
verdict.programmeConsequence: claim 1559 must be reopened from two to three carrier strategies: 32-state ordinary Spin(10)/Pati-Salam, 16-state left-right twisted, and 27-state chiral E6. The 27 branch is the best parent-unification route but needs a declared E6 outer twist or a 54-state ordinary completion, an added 351'_H or effective Majorana operator, a broken-phase grading prescription, and an independent family/threshold law.

boundary: This is a representation, anomaly, invariant-channel and source-count audit. It does not construct an E6-breaking vacuum, solve doublet-triplet splitting, audit disconnected global anomalies, or calculate the complete threshold and beta-function system.
